content:
Maya Patel: FYI Mavenly returned the vendor questionnaire. A few gaps that could block their renewal if we don't clarify by EOD Fri — SOC2 scope looks inconsistent and they asked about BYOK for embeddings. Can we triage?
Priya Nair: Can you list the specific gaps? I can take the SOC2 scoping clarifications.
Maya Patel: Sure — they marked 'production only' for SOC2 but their data flow diagram references staging that receives PII from integrations. Also they asked which subprocessors store derived embeddings and for retention periods.
Ethan Cruz: Uploaded the redlined questionnaire here: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-mavenly-qna (see comments). Key Qs: 1) SOC2 in-scope envs 2) KMS/BYOK acceptance 3) retention for embeddings.
Samir Khan: For BYOK: we currently support customer-managed keys for Private deployments and Dedicated with enterprise KMS options. For hosted, we have provider-managed keys only. Should we offer a security exception request for hosted if they need BYOK?
Alex Li: @Samir correct. Also: if embeddings are considered personal data, retention defaults to 30 days for logs and 365 days for embeddings by contract, but we can negotiate shorter retention in the DPA amendment.
Priya Nair: I'll draft a short response clarifying SOC2 scope: "SOC2 covers production + any environment that processes customer PII (staging receiving PII is in scope)." Want to confirm wording before I send.
Maya Patel: That wording sounds good. Also add a line: "We log anonymized request metadata by default; embedding vectors are stored encrypted at rest and can be purged on request."
Ethan Cruz: Quick technical note to include: code snippet for their SRE team to prove nonprod segregation:
```
# example: env tag check
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/environments | jq '.[] | {name, env, data_handling}'
```
Samir Khan: I'll own the KMS/BYOK paragraph and note that for hosted customers we can discuss a SOC2 attestation route but BYOK requires Private/Dedicated.
security-bot: Created ticket CS-4521 (mavenly-qna) assigned to @Priya, @Samir. Checklist added: [SOC2 scope note, KMS/BYOK explainer, embeddings retention clause]. Reminder: SLA for answers to vendor form is 72h. :bell:
Maya Patel: Thanks all — I'll push to Mavenly with the draft today and flag renewal owner. :thumbsup:
thread_text: Mavenly vendor questionnaire triage: SOC2 scope, BYOK, embeddings retention
